content_text: The color is always justified in some way. I certainly don’t use color to ‘look good’. In BR2049 I wanted the interior of the Wallace Corporation to look as if it were sun lit. That was the reasoning there. Our Las Vegas was red as Denis thought it would contrast the cold look of LA., besides Sidney had just been enveloped in a red dust storm so it seemed it was part of our new reality.
